verdict.rationale: Jan's API Reference documents a POST /v1/messages endpoint described as 'Anthropic-compatible'. Jan translates requests to its internal format so Anthropic SDK clients can point at the local server, and the docs include curl examples and sample responses. The docs also mention connecting Claude Code, which is consistent with this endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works with Anthropic SDKs, and documented coverage of streaming and tool use specifically on /v1/messages (those are documented only for chat/completions).
